Running the family business? You don’t need to step away to do this.

Ascend runs on weekends: a live class on Saturday, a founder session on Sunday and one weekday team check-in. About 10 hours a week. Classes are online, with 6 short campus blocks in Bangalore.

You learn on weekends and apply it at work on Monday. Apply now.
